 MOUSE   
   
1\.OBJECTIVE 

-         To identify the major components of wired computer mouse and understand their function and role .

2\. COMPONENTS 

- SW1 \- Slide switch   
- SW2 \- Slide switch   
- SW3 \- Slide switch   
- SW4 \- Slide switch   
- EN1 \- rotary / encoder switch   
- C2 \- electrolytic capacitor   
- IC \- integrated circuit / controller IC   
- CN1 \- connector for external cable   
- PCB \- printed circuit board   
- USB connector / cable \- power and data connection   
- MOUSE HOUSING / body \- productive encloesr   
- Scroll wheel \- user input wheel


2 . FUNCTION 

- Controls a mouse function or operating mode  
- Detects scroll wheel rotation   
- Smooth and stabilise the power supply  
- Process input signal and communicates with the computer .  
- Connects the PCB and the USB cable .  
- supports and connects the electronic components.  
- supplies power and transfers data.  
- protects and holds the internal parts.  
- provides scrolling input.  
   

3 . WORKING PRINCIPLE 

- The USB cable supplies power to the mouse and provides the data connection to the computer   
- The mouse buttons and scroll wheel  generate input signals when operated by the user   
- The rotary encoder detects the direction and movement of the scroll wheel   
- The controller IC processes the input signals   
- The processed data is sent to the computer through the USB connection   
- The computer interprets the signals as cursor movement , clicking ,scrolling ,or other mouse function 


4\. CONCLUTION  
Reverse engineering the mouse help us understand how mechanical inputs are converted into electrical signals , processed by the controller IC , and transferred to a computer through a USB interface
